text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; fill: #1d3557

g.text: Quantizer-aware geometry, energy concentration and range-law behavior. (a) All 8,064 non-BOS layer-27

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; fill: #1d3557

g.text: down-input token projections in the frozen (v1,v2) basis, standardized separately, with unit free-direction

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; fill: #1d3557

g.text: projections shown at the same multiplier of 1.0. Their in-plane lengths are 0.015 for Hadamard and 1.000 for

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; fill: #1d3557

g.text: PrismQuant; direction cosines are distinct from token standard deviations. (b) Seven depth-spanning layers:

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; fill: #1d3557

g.text: 1, 5, 9, 13, 18, 22 and 27. Solid curves preserve the original BOS-excluded rank-256 spectra at layers 1/13/27.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; fill: #1d3557

g.text: Dashed curves use existing all-token rank-64 spectra at layers 5/9/18/22 and stop at the measured endpoint;

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; fill: #1d3557

g.text: they are not continuations of the solid-curve protocol. The common all-token protocol for all seven layers is

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; fill: #1d3557

g.text: shown in the appendix. (c) All 2,520 activation, 280 V-cache and 112 multi-slot observations, with the

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; fill: #1d3557

g.text: unchanged pooled reference y=0.059802+0.866515x (R²=0.86); x=√(1−f) and y is range relative to paired

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; fill: #1d3557

g.text: Hadamard. The gray dashed line is identity. (d) All 5,342 available Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base expert

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; fill: #1d3557

g.text: observations, excluded from the reference fit. Marker area is fixed; teal denotes <2,048 routed calibration

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; fill: #1d3557

g.text: tokens and blue ≥2,048. Brown points connect medians in ten equal-count f bins; vertical intervals show

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; fill: #1d3557

g.text: Q1–Q3, not confidence intervals. The blue line is the unchanged reference from c; no MoE line is fitted for

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; fill: #1d3557

g.text: display. Within-MoE OLS association R² is 0.61 for the 4,955 experts reaching the original 256-row cap and

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; fill: #1d3557

g.text: 0.43 for all experts; transferred-reference predictive R² is 0.61/0.43, respectively. The full-row median y/x is

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; fill: #1d3557

g.text: 0.95. Removing the 263 experts with f>0.5 reduces x variance by 71.38% and within-subset R² to 0.19,

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; fill: #1d3557

g.text: illustrating range sensitivity. Cold-expert reference residuals have 3.82× the hot-expert standard deviation.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; fill: #1d3557

g.text: Their covariance uses the original layer-pooled shrinkage prior; this association does not isolate its causal

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; fill: #1d3557

g.text: effect. Expert evaluation rows come from their calibration capture, so cross-model holdout applies to the

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; fill: #1d3557

g.text: dense reference fit, not to expert calibration.
